separately_excluded_from_this_check.reason: These four keys are not Uganda candidates; the retained full-family overlay records Angola ADM1 Uíge and COD ADM2 Kimvula.

official_comparator.creator: Uganda Bureau of Statistics
official_comparator.title: County Boundaries: Uganda, 2006
official_comparator.catalog_description: Polygon county boundaries, Level 4 / ADM4, based on 2006 data; item record declares public domain and says downloadable data are in native coordinate system.

coordinate_reference_review.used_definition: Embedded .prj identifies WGS 84 UTM Zone 36N with central meridian 33 degrees, scale 0.9996, false easting 500000 m, and custom false northing 200000 m.
coordinate_reference_review.crosscheck: Reprojection under the embedded .prj reproduced shapefile coordinate bounds [118484.0404, 36309.7602, 722525.5000, 668071.0000], matching its recorded spatial extent.
coordinate_reference_review.conflicting_metadata: The ISO metadata identifies EPSG:32736, and the ESRI metadata includes a Zone 36S / 10000000 m false-northing definition. These conflict with the embedded .prj and observed coordinate extent.
coordinate_reference_review.impact: All containment counts are provisional source-relative center comparisons because of this internal projection-metadata conflict; no boundary or ownership conclusion relies on them.

method.point_source: Center coordinates from the already retained complete-537-feature-center-overlay.json; no new center/geometry derivation for the COD target was run.
method.projection: WGS 84 ellipsoid; UTM Zone 36N, k=0.9996, central meridian 33 degrees, false easting 500000 m, false northing 200000 m, following the dataset .prj.
method.spatial_test: Ray-crossing point-in-polygon against each of the 164 UBOS county polygons, after bounding-box pruning. This tests recorded cell centers only, not whole-cell intersection or boundary ties.
method.initial_pilot_correction: An earlier exploratory pass omitted the .prj custom false northing; its results were discarded and are not reported.

interpretation_and_limits: The official UBOS county source does not reproduce the registered candidate-label partition: 30 Bughendra-labeled centers fall in the UBOS 2006 Bwamba polygon and 50 of 112 fall in no UBOS county polygon under the used projection.
These differences are evidence of product/geometry or metadata disagreement, not proof that the registered Uganda source does or does not apply to an original COD cell.
Center containment does not establish full-cell physical/native qualification, territorial exclusion, source-member attribution, or legal/current ownership.

The result does not fill the missing source-evidence target rows for Irumu and Kimvula, does not resolve GNQ or other family applicability, and changes no hold, owner, patch, disposition, denominator, prior credit, or selected product.
The source archive is retained only in local temporary storage; only the archive digest, metadata, method, and aggregate counts are recorded here. No coordinates or raw geometry are redistributed.
